capture.title: Upload & review
capture.description: Review a receipt or screenshot and confirm its details before saving a record.
capture.privacy: Prototype only: the image stays in this browser tab and is never sent to a service. Only reviewed transaction fields are saved; the image preview is discarded when you leave this screen.
capture.imageLabel: Receipt or screenshot (JPEG, PNG, or WebP; up to 5 MB)
capture.fileTypeError: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
capture.emptyFileError: That image file is empty. Choose another file or enter the details manually.
capture.fileSizeError: The image must be 5 MB or smaller. Choose a smaller image or enter the details manually.
capture.previewAlt: Local preview of the selected receipt or screenshot
capture.manual: Image unreadable or unavailable · enter manually
capture.sampleNotice: Sample extraction · simulated, not OCR. These example fields may be wrong; review and correct each one.
capture.manualNotice: Manual entry selected. Enter the details you can read from the receipt, or continue without an image.
capture.chooseReviewMode: Choose sample extraction or manual entry before reviewing fields.
capture.reviewHelp: Check the amount, date, payment status, category, and description. This prototype does not read the image.
capture.confirmReview: I reviewed and confirm these transaction fields.
capture.reviewRequired: Review the fields and confirm them before saving.
capture.saved: Reviewed transaction saved. The image was not stored.

owed.title: Who owes what
owed.description: Keep incoming payments and outgoing obligations distinct.
owed.assumptionsExcluded: These assumptions are not included in outstanding totals.

schedules.title: Plan the next payment
schedules.description: One-time and monthly payments, with a shared lifecycle.
schedules.addHelp: Future payments stay scheduled. When due, the demo records an unconfirmed assumption for you to review. Monthly schedules catch up missed months and show a rolling one-year forecast.
schedules.forecastHelp: Monthly schedules show past occurrences and a rolling one-year forecast. Forecasts do not count in cash totals.
schedules.saveError: This schedule could not be saved. Check the details and try again.
schedules.confirmUnpaid: Mark this payment as unpaid? Its cash movement will be removed and the obligation restored.

insights.title: Look ahead with clarity
insights.description: Understand upcoming obligations and patterns in your records.
insights.ruleHelp: Rule-based observations with supporting records. These are prompts to review, not financial advice.
insights.noSignals: No signals meet the current data thresholds.
insights.overdueObserved: {{count}} unpaid item(s), totaling {{amount}} MMK, have a due date before today.
insights.overdueInterpretation: Review these items and update their payment status when you have confirmed it.
insights.upcomingObserved: {{count}} unpaid item(s), totaling {{amount}} MMK, are due soon.
insights.upcomingInterpretation: Check that the expected dates and amounts still match your plans.
insights.unusualObserved: A recorded expense of {{amount}} MMK is more than twice the prior median of {{median}} MMK for this category.
insights.unusualInterpretation: This is a comparison with your own earlier records, not a judgement about the purchase.
insights.spendingSpikeObserved: This month's settled expenses are {{current}} MMK, compared with {{previous}} MMK last month.
insights.spendingSpikeInterpretation: Both months have at least three settled expense records; compare the underlying entries for context.
insights.concentrationObserved: {{percent}}% of this month's settled expenses ({{amount}} MMK) are in {{category}}.
insights.concentrationInterpretation: This describes the current record mix and does not label a category as good or bad.
insights.incompleteObserved: {{count}} settled transaction(s) have no category recorded.
insights.incompleteInterpretation: Adding a category can make later summaries more useful.
insights.duplicatesObserved: {{count}} exact-match pair(s) have enough matching details to review.
insights.duplicatesInterpretation: Check each pair before removing anything. Legitimate repeat payments can look similar.
insights.shortfallObserved: The expected case projects {{base}} MMK shortfall; the delayed-inflow case projects {{delayed}} MMK.
insights.shortfallInterpretation: This estimate uses your opening balance and recorded obligations; it is not a verified account balance.
insights.duplicatesHelp: Only strong matches are shown. Review both records and choose whether to keep both or remove one.
insights.confirmRemove: Remove the selected transaction? This action cannot be undone.
items: Review possible duplicates or keep both

forecast.openingRequired: Set an opening balance to view the cash-flow forecast.
forecast.disclaimer: Estimated from your recorded available balance, unpaid obligations and scheduled occurrences. This is not a bank balance or financial advice. The delayed-inflow case moves expected income seven days later.

chat.title: Ask your companion
chat.description: A rule-based demonstration grounded in records saved in this browser.
chat.limits: Rule-based demo only. Answers use records currently saved in this browser. Unsupported questions and requests for financial, legal or tax advice are declined.
chat.questionPlaceholder: For example: What do I owe?
chat.unsupportedAnswer: I can answer questions about recorded totals, expenses, categories, owed payments, overdue items, the cash-flow forecast, and document checklist status. I can't predict loan approval or provide financial, legal, or tax advice.
chat.documentsAnswer: You marked {{completed}} of {{total}} supporting document checklist items as available.
chat.overdueAnswer: {{count}} unpaid item(s) are overdue, totaling {{amount}} MMK.
chat.outstandingAnswer: You have {{receivable}} MMK in unpaid incoming payments and {{payable}} MMK in unpaid obligations.
chat.forecastMissingOpening: Set an opening balance before asking about the cash-flow forecast.
chat.forecastAnswer: The expected case's lowest projected balance is {{minimum}} MMK. The delayed-inflow case has a projected shortfall of {{delayedShortfall}} MMK.
chat.topExpenseAnswer: Your largest settled expense this month is {{amount}} MMK.
chat.categoryAnswer: The largest expense category this month is {{category}} at {{amount}} MMK.
chat.periodAnswer: This month, recorded settled income is {{income}} MMK and expenses are {{expenses}} MMK, for net movement of {{net}} MMK.
chat.noTransactionsAnswer: There are no matching settled records for this period.

readiness.disclaimer: This checklist describes records you have entered or say you have available. It is not a credit score, creditworthiness assessment, or loan approval prediction. No document files are uploaded here.
readiness.recordChecksHelp: These checks update from the records saved in this browser.
readiness.documentsHelp: Mark items you have available. This records checklist status only; it does not upload or store document files.
